newsitem.title: UK: Syria tenders to buy white, raw sugar - trade.
newsitem.headline: Syria tenders to buy white, raw sugar - trade.

text.p: Syria has tendered to buy 13,000 tonnes of white sugar and 13,000 tonnes of raws for shipment in February, trade sources said on Friday.
The tender would be held on January 8, they said.
Late in November, Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation (GEZA) bought 13,000 tonnes of raws at $292.75 a tonne for Dec 20/Jan 20 delivery but cancelled a tender to buy the same amount of whites.
GEZA said a few days later it did not expect to issue any more sugar tenders until the end of 1996. --Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064
